english.title: Solemnize a marriage in registered building in the absence of a district registrar
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and wilfully solemnized a marriage between **(..SPECIFY PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) in

(A)_[the registered building office]_
(B)_[approved premises]_
(C)_[person's residence]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) specified as the place where the marriage was to be solemnized in the notices of marriage and certificates required under Part III of the Marriage Act 1949, in the absence of a registrar of the district in which the registered building was situated
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(2)(b) of the Marriage Act 1949.
